requirements.originalBreakdownItem: Preserve the required order: answer the question → catch fruit → reveal basket.
requirements.changes: Question retrieval has a cancellable generation/session/topic/difficulty identity. Leaving or replacing loading, changing topic/difficulty and starting a new request cancel the previous request. Late successes/failures cannot change the new screen or write the wrong topic’s question history. Valid question metadata must match the requested topic/difficulty. Leaving loading returns to usable setup.
requirements.verification: Three lifecycle tests with deliberately late/noncooperative provider callbacks and actual bundled grounded questions were added. Not executed on Mac. Existing bad-fruit/no-pass termination, exactly-one pass consumption and uncapped star-pass accumulation already exist and were not rewritten.
requirements.remainingIssues: Run new lifecycle tests and complete actual game UI sequence on founder Mac. These source changes do not establish full gameplay acceptance.

requirements.originalBreakdownItem: Playable questions must have unambiguous choices and pinned, approved original evidence; requested topic/difficulty association must be correct.
requirements.changes: Malformed duplicate/blank option and citation identities, duplicate choice text, empty questions/explanations/version locks are rejected. A shared snapshot check requires the original passage/package, unique source records, approved-source display eligibility and nonempty original source versions. The adapter and actual question-loading boundary both require this snapshot; source IDs alone do not approve a scientific question.
requirements.verification: Three integrity XCTest cases with multiple malformed decoded-JSON subcases added; lifecycle coverage extended to difficulty changes (four lifecycle cases). Not executed on Mac.
requirements.remainingIssues: Run canonical provider/menu/topic/difficulty regressions and full actual game journeys. Structural approval metadata is not independent clinical review.

requirements.originalBreakdownItem: Allow star passes to accumulate without a fixed maximum.
requirements.changes: Basket artwork no longer fabricates catches from the allowed fruit pool. Classification and reveal use actual registered artwork; accepted classification bad fruit now records its real identity without duplicating frame-driven catches. All registered stars remain in the model. A bounded drawing projection shows eight already-collected star icons plus an exact additional-stars count, while always showing pending artwork needed for real settling acknowledgement. This is not a pass or catch-record cap. Paused classification cannot consume passes or register fruit.
requirements.verification: Five new cases: 12 actual frame/settling acknowledgements retain 12 stars/passes; actual classified good/bad identities and one-pass use; paused classification safety; empty and bounded artwork projections. Not executed on Mac. Existing collision/settling/scoring assertions remain unchanged.
requirements.remainingIssues: Run full normal/largest game UI journeys, reveal screenshots, strict accessibility, restart/source snapshots and animation recordings.
